subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 3: Vocabulary – technology in the home
outcomes: Name items of technology in the home.
Use phrasal verbs like switch off, turn down and plug in correctly.
Know which phrasal verbs can be separated.

tf.why: Yes, it washes plates and cups.
With a pronoun we say 'Plug it in first.'

tf.s: With a separable phrasal verb, a pronoun goes between the verb and the particle.
'Go off' and 'come on' can be separated.
tf.why: They cannot be separated and have no object.

tf.s: 'Turn down' means make the sound quieter.
tf.why: Turn down the TV when it is too loud.

tf.s: 'Dishwasher' and 'microwave' are written as one word.
tf.why: These compound nouns are one word.

tf.s: 'Washing machine' is written as one word.
tf.why: It is two words: washing machine.

tf.s: 'Turn up the heating' means make it warmer.
tf.why: 'Turn up' makes it higher or stronger.

tf.s: In the power-cut story, the power went off for two weeks.
tf.why: It went off for two days.

tf.s: Switching off devices you are not using saves electricity.

boxes.q: It's too loud! Can you ___ the TV?

boxes.why: The pronoun goes between the verb and the particle.

boxes.q: Complete: I was so happy when the power ___ on again.
Which phrasal verb means 'connect to the electricity'?
boxes.why: We plug in a phone to charge it.

boxes.q: Which phrasal verb means 'get a new device ready to use'?
boxes.why: We set up a new device.

boxes.q: What was Zakeya's main problem during the power cut?
boxes.why: She couldn't plug in her phone, so the battery died.

boxes.q: Which item keeps a room cool?
Complete: When we take the last pizza, the freezer will ___ us to buy more.

hunt.q: How long did the power go off?

mcq.q: Which phrasal verb CANNOT be separated?
mcq.why: 'Go off' has no object, so we can't separate it.

mcq.q: Which items are written as one word?
mcq.why: Dishwasher and microwave are one word each.

mcq.q: Which phrasal verb means 'start a machine'?
Where does the pronoun go with a separable phrasal verb?
o: Between the verb and the particle
At the start of the sentence
mcq.why: Switch it on, plug it in, take them off.

mcq.q: Rewrite with 'it': Switch off the light.
mcq.why: The pronoun goes in the middle.

mcq.q: Your phone battery is low. What do you do?
mcq.why: Plug it in to charge it.

mcq.q: Complete: The lights suddenly ___ and the room was dark.
Why can't we say 'The lights went them off'?
o: 'Go off' has no object and cannot be separated.

mcq.q: 'Can you ___ the TV? It's too loud.' Why is 'turn down' the right answer?
o: It means make the sound quieter.
mcq.why: A loud TV needs to be quieter.

mcq.q: A student invents a smart schoolbag that checks the timetable. How does it make life easier?
o: It reminds you what to take to school.
mcq.why: A smart device should solve a real problem.
